text: Sam D. is a great instructor at Brazos Valley Flight Services. He's very straightforward, realistic, and doesn't sugarcoat anything, which I really appreciate as a student pilot. He's especially great for students who are serious and committed to becoming better pilots. Sam has helped me a lot throughout my training, and I'm grateful for the time and guidance he's given me. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for an honest and knowledgeable instructor.

text: I've been flying here for the past few months with Samuel Dvorak and have been extremely satisfied the entire time. Not only is the flight school itself well rounded but the pilots as well. Their knowledge and personality make learning the mechanics and getting comfortable flying so easy. A trait I admire more about my own instructor Sam is that he is always letting me lead when flying and allows me to make mistakes to continue improving. I just recently had my solo at Easterwood and felt extremely ready and comfortable because of my training. I would highly recommend flying with Brazos valley and more importantly with Sam if you get the chance!
